mapper.select: select * from room order by room_no asc
mapper.update: update room set room_name = #{roomName} where room_no = #{roomNo}
mapper.delete: delete from party where party_room = #{partyRoom} and party_account = #{partyAccount}
mapper.select: select R.*, nvl2(P.party_room, 'Y', 'N') room_enter from room R left outer join ( select * from party where party_account = #{partyAccount} ) P on R.room_no = P.party_room order by R.room_no asc
